{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies CMakeLists.txt and cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in to handle CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR and CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR relative path calculations for installed binaries.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.62,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes installation layout breakage on Linux distributions like Arch Linux where non-default libexec directories break the installed wrapper executable. In build, resolving supported-platform and packaging run-time breakage is high priority."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly touches src/bitcoin.cpp, the main wrapper executable for multiprocess binaries, and its build/test configuration.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.62,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves issue #35785 where subcommands like 'bitcoin -m node' fail immediately with 'No such file or directory' on distributions using non-default install layouts. Ensuring multiprocess wrapper executables can reliably locate and spawn internal binaries is core to IPC usability."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/bitcoin.cpp and test/functional/tool_bitcoin.py, modifying the 'bitcoin' command-line wrapper tool.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a fatal bug where the 'bitcoin' wrapper fails to execute any subcommands on distros configured with non-default install paths. The tool is unusable under these packaging configurations without this fix."
    }
  ],
